decisions.reason: The prize count and draw-frequency adjustment does not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, limit, or expiration.
Changing prize counts and draw intervals does not resolve or alter whether prizes are delivered automatically or claimed from the Winners page.
Message 158 does not mention or necessarily change Aave or prize-pool yield behavior; any later statement about Aave is outside this source Event.
A same-message MODIFY already updates both FAQ prize descriptions to one $500 prize every 100 sales and one $10,000 prize every 10,000 sales.
A same-message MODIFY already records the Big Block winner count, 10,000-sale trigger, and exact interval while retaining the unchanged $10,000 prize amount.
A same-message MODIFY already updates the Mission page's prize-pool content with both revised prize counts and sales intervals.
The revised prize counts and draw intervals do not change Chainlink VRF, ticket weighting, eligible ticket holders, on-chain execution, fairness, or verification.
A same-message MODIFY already records one winner, a $500 draw pool, a 100-sale interval, and that the interval is exact.
Changing prize counts and draw intervals does not alter transfer of the book, referral identity, badges, or active and expired ticket state upon resale.
The prize adjustment does not change the mint-number referral-code basis, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
Both Small and Big Block ticket counters remain required; the revised draw cadence does not change which counters, badges, or referral-code attribute must appear in metadata.
The source explicitly preserves the same net giveaway amounts, and both Small and Big Block pools remain active destinations; no mint price or per-sale allocation change is entailed.
